unmatched.summary: Layout boxes (a scored layer) are measured with page.evaluate in the main world of a page whose JavaScript the clone serves, so the clone can override Element.prototype.getBoundingClientRect or innerText and report any boxes it likes. This defeats the separate-process isolation that is supposed to stop the clone from patching the scorer.
unmatched.evidence: ui.ts:187-210 calls el.getBoundingClientRect() and el.innerText inside page.evaluate on the clone's portal page. A Playwright test page whose own <script> replaces Element.prototype.getBoundingClientRect made page.evaluate return [592,132,49,23], while locator.boundingBox() gave the real box {x:500,y:500,w:35.5,h:18}. The iframe masks for the thumbnail (ui.ts:225-229) are measured the same way. The current clone does not do this (no prototype overrides in clone/*.ts), but the evaluator cannot detect it if it did.

unmatched.summary: `cli.ts explain` scores the holdout (its default split) against the clone and prints every field diff and input. It never checks the evaluator lock and never appends to verify/runs.jsonl, so holdout looks taken this way go uncounted and can run on a tampered evaluator.
unmatched.evidence: cli.ts:80-83: the explain branch defaults to splits ['holdout'] and calls explain() with no checkLock or committedLockProblems. explain.ts:133-162 has no appendFileSync or runs.jsonl write. verify.ts:184-196 is the only writer of runs.jsonl, and looksPerSet (fidelity.ts:219) counts only those lines. Yet docs/verification.md says the run log makes 'the number of looks at a holdout ... a fact'.

unmatched.summary: The builder-visible verify/report.md is built from all loaded fixtures, so its 'Declared blind spots' section lists the ID and recorded-noise paths of every holdout fixture. Noise paths include keys taken from on-screen text.
unmatched.evidence: verify.ts:146 passes `fixtures` (dev and holdout when --split all) to report(..., 'dev'). report() at verify.ts:497-500 prints `f.id` and `f.noise` for every fixture with noise, with no split filter. report.md has no 'holdout' in its name, so make-sandbox.sh copies it into the builder sandbox (confirmed by building a sandbox in /tmp/sbx). Every fixture currently has an empty noise list, so nothing leaks today, but the code is wrong.

unmatched.summary: The guard hook logs to <repo>/logs/guard.log. make-sandbox.sh excludes only targets/*/logs and .gitignore does not cover logs/, so the guard log (blocked holdout paths and commands from other agents) is copied into every implementer sandbox and can be committed.
unmatched.evidence: guard-oracle.sh:19 sets log=$(dirname $0)/../../logs/guard.log, which is the repository root's logs/. After guard entries were written during this audit, running `harness/make-sandbox.sh /work /tmp/sbx` copied ./logs/guard.log into the sandbox. `git status` lists `?? logs/` (not ignored).
